name: TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer
description: The TCA9548A component allows you to use TCA9548A as a I²C multiplexer ([datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tca9548a.pdf), [AdaFruit](https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-tca9548a-1-to-8-i2c-multiplexer-breakout)) in ESPHome. It uses [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) for communication.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: Manually specify the I²C address of the multiplexer. Defaults to `0x70`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The upstream I²C bus to use. Required when more than one I²C bus is configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id to use for this TCA9548A component.

config_entries.label: Bus ID
config_entries.description: The id to use for this virtual I²C bus.

config_entries.label: Channel
config_entries.description: The channel (0-7) to use for this virtual I²C bus.

config_entries.label: Frequency
config_entries.description: The frequency for the devices on this virtual I²C bus. Defaults to the multiplexer's frequency, or the main bus frequency. On nRF52 the controller only distinguishes standard (100 kHz) and fast (400 kHz and above) mode, so other values round to one of those.

config_entries.label: Frequency
config_entries.description: The frequency the multiplexer itself is addressed at, and the default for its channels. Set it when the main bus runs faster than the multiplexer supports, 400 kHz for the TCA9548A. Without it the multiplexer is addressed at the main bus frequency, or at the slower of the main bus and the channel frequency when the channel sets one.
